body.value: Your generosity helps Bread of Life Christian Church worship, serve our neighbors, and share the hope of Jesus. Thank you for partnering with us through your giving.
您的奉献帮助生命面包基督教会敬拜、服事邻舍，并分享耶稣所带来的盼望。感谢您用奉献与我们一同服事。

paymentInstructions.value: Scan the QR code, and follow the instructions to make a secure donation through Zelle.
